import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = {
    "source0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_0.csv",
    "source1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_1.csv",

    "source6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_6.csv",
    "source7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_7.csv",
    "source8": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_8.csv",
    "source9": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_9.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source0"], index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source1"], index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source2"], index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source3"], index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source4"], index_col=0)
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source5"], index_col=0)
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source6"], index_col=0)
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source7"], index_col=0)
df8 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source8"], index_col=0)
df9 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source9"], index_col=0)

# Step 2: Union all source tables that share the same schema as the target except the *_NUM columns
# Source 0, 2, 3, 9 have the same schema:
# ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']

# Concatenate these four dataframes vertically (union)
df_main = pd.concat([df0, df2, df3, df9], ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Join the aspect tables (source1,4,5,6,7,8) on ROW_WID to the main dataframe
# These tables have one column each besides ROW_WID:
# source1: COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM
# source4: INBOUND_CALLS_NUM
# source5: VISITS_NUM
# source6: INTERACTIONS_NUM
# source7: KEYWORDS_NUM
# source8: TECHSUPPORT_NUM

# We will left join on ROW_WID to keep all rows from df_main

# Join source1
df_main = df_main.merge(df1, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join source4
df_main = df_main.merge(df4, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join source5
df_main = df_main.merge(df5, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join source6
df_main = df_main.merge(df6, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join source7
df_main = df_main.merge(df7, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join source8
df_main = df_main.merge(df8, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Step 4: Fill missing numeric columns (from joins) with 0, as these represent counts or numeric measures
count_columns = [
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM",
    "VISITS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM",
    "INTERACTIONS_NUM",
]

for col in count_columns:
    if col in df_main.columns:
        df_main[col] = df_main[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Step 5: Ensure data types match the target schema exactly

# Target schema:
# ['CANCELED': int, 'ROW_WID': int, 'ACCNT_LOC': int, 'ARPU': float, 'SES': str,
#  'HOME_PASSED': int, 'CUST_SINCE_DT': str, 'MONTHS_AGE': float, 'CANCEL_DT': str,
#  'CITY': str, 'POP': str, 'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM': int, 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM': int,
#  'KEYWORDS_NUM': int, 'VISITS_NUM': int, 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM': int, 'INTERACTIONS_NUM': int]

# Convert columns accordingly

# Integer columns

    "CANCELED",

    "HOME_PASSED",
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM",
    "VISITS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM",

# String columns

for col in str_cols:

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all main tables with the same schema (Source0, Source2, Source3, Source9)
unioned_main = pd.concat([source0, source2, source3, source9], ignore_index=True)

# JOIN unioned_main with Source1 on ROW_WID
joined_01 = pd.merge(unioned_main, source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# JOIN with Source4 on ROW_WID
joined_04 = pd.merge(joined_01, source4, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# JOIN with Source7 on ROW_WID
joined_07 = pd.merge(joined_04, source7, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# JOIN with Source5 on ROW_WID
joined_05 = pd.merge(joined_07, source5, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# JOIN with Source8 on ROW_WID
joined_08 = pd.merge(joined_05, source8, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# JOIN with Source6 on ROW_WID
final_joined = pd.merge(joined_08, source6, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# GROUP BY the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema:
# According to target schema and hints, group by:
# CANCELED (int), ROW_WID (int), ACCNT_LOC (int), SES (str), HOME_PASSED (int), CUST_SINCE_DT (str), CANCEL_DT (str), CITY (str), POP (str)
# Aggregate:
# ARPU (float) - max (to keep max ARPU per group)
# MONTHS_AGE (float) - max (to keep max months_age per group)
# COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM, INBOUND_CALLS_NUM, KEYWORDS_NUM, VISITS_NUM, TECHSUPPORT_NUM, INTERACTIONS_NUM - sum (counts)

group_cols = [
    "CANCELED", "ROW_WID", "ACCNT_LOC", "SES", "HOME_PASSED",
    "CUST_SINCE_DT", "CANCEL_DT", "CITY", "POP"
]

agg_dict = {
    "ARPU": "max",
    "MONTHS_AGE": "max",
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM": "sum",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM": "sum",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM": "sum",
    "VISITS_NUM": "sum",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM": "sum",
    "INTERACTIONS_NUM": "sum"
}

result = final_joined.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False, as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED',
    'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP',
    'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM', 'KEYWORDS_NUM',
    'VISITS_NUM', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM'
]

result = result[target_columns]

# Write to output CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_27/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
